【話題】
現行のClaudeだけで、音楽連動の3D粒子アニメーションを作った事例が話題だ😳
Fable 5もGPT-5.6も不要、という主張をコードで見せている

https://t.co/2sejm4uTIh

動作している技術は4つ👇

・流体粒子 → Simplex ノイズで軌跡を制御、ランダムでなく有機的な動き
・GPGPU → 数千個の粒子をGPUで並列更新、スマホで60fps
・音楽連動シェーダー → 音楽の周波数データにリングがパルス
・Selective bloom → 明るい部分だけがグロー、Three.js + GSAP + Lenis で動く

GPUシェーダーや音楽連動レンダリングは、3Dエンジニアが専門で扱う領域だった

それを現行のClaudeで書いた実例が出てきた
@threejs Fable 5 make threejs run on my local GPU
@victormustar I had given Fable a t^3 sahur three.js benchmark upon release and it failed all attempts

GLM 5.2 vs Claude Fable 5 vs Claude Opus 4.8: the battle for the AI developer crown

the latest benchmark shows open models aren't just catching up to closed flagships - they are out-designing them.

one sandbox. two prompts. a playable Minecraft clone from scratch:

> Three.js graphics with sand, forest, and snow biomes
> transparent window rendering with sharp outer edges
> interactive crafting table with custom plank recipes
> procedural ore generation: coal, iron, gold
> underground cave generation and day-night cycle
> stable 60 FPS rendering

the graphics advantage:

GLM 5.2 solved complex window transparency where others broke, beating ChatGPT 5.5, Kimi, and Claude Opus 4.8. the entire scene rendered in 20 minutes

logic vs world generation:

> Claude Fable 5 dominates on core architecture and stable physics (it built a working sprint mechanic)
> GLM 5.2 excelled in world-building, adding unprompted cave systems and mob loot

the bugs:

health bars clip behind the inventory ui, mined blocks teleport straight to item slots, and attacked zombies drift upward

the choice comes down to raw logic vs visual complexity. which setup runs your development stack?
